# Delhi — municipal winner qualifications

*Generated by `make state-readmes`. Edit the generator or data.*

[Winner Parquet](release/winners.parquet) contains one elected ward per year, with reservation, assembly constituency, education, age and pending cases. This supplementary winner release is separate from the pooled seat-event schema.

| Election | Winners | Linked profiles | Education category present | Age | Pending cases |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 2012 | 272 | 237 | 237 | 235 | 237 |
| 2017 | 272 | 267 | 267 | 262 | 267 |
| 2022 | 250 | 248 | 248 | 248 | 248 |

Education coverage counts any nonempty source category, including unspecified categories. Analytical classification can therefore have a smaller denominator. Missing profiles remain unknown; conviction tables are excluded from pending cases.

Goyal's replication deposit supplies the 2012/2017 winner rosters and assembly mapping. OpenCity/Lok Dhaba supplies 2022 winners; the SEC gazette supplies 2022 reservation and assembly identifiers. Individual MyNeta profiles supply qualifications. Joins require unique year/ward keys and matching winner parties.

Run `make delhi` to rebuild offline and `make delhi-harvest` to resume collection. [Sources](release/source_manifest.json), [dictionary](release/schema.json), [release hashes](release/manifest.json), [profile cache manifest](qualification_audit/fetch_manifest.csv) and [winner matching audit](release/winner_source_audit.parquet) retain provenance. The paper in `quota_elite_quality` reads this typed handoff.
